run_AVAVisualizerWithPrecomputedBox: run the AVAVisualizerWithPrecomputedBox class to visualize action predictions on a video with precomputed bounding boxes
build_AVAVisualizerWithPrecomputedBox_ge: build predictions for precomputed boxes by running get_predictions on AVAVisualizerWithPrecomputedBox to classify actions in each box
create_AVAVisualizerWithPrecomputedBox_d: create a visualized output video by calling draw_video on AVAVisualizerWithPrecomputedBox to render predictions and ground-truth boxes
test_merge_pred_gt_boxes: test the merge_pred_gt_boxes function to merge predicted and ground-truth bounding box dictionaries into a unified structure
review_load_boxes_labels: review the load_boxes_labels function to parse AVA bounding box CSV files and return prediction and ground-truth box dictionaries
